name: check_room
description: Check whether a room is available for a requested interval without changing state. All times are whole minutes since midnight, in the inclusive range 0 to 1440. This tool does not save or create a booking. Supply the current time, blocked status, and all existing bookings; ask for missing information rather than guessing.

start.description: Requested start in whole minutes since midnight.

end.description: Requested end in whole minutes since midnight.

now.description: Current time in whole minutes since midnight.

bookings.description: All existing bookings; an empty list is allowed.

start.description: Existing booking start in whole minutes since midnight.

end.description: Existing booking end in whole minutes since midnight.
